definitions.explanation: A natural flowing body of water. One of the basic nature words in Japanese.

examples.japanese: この{川|かわ}で{魚|さかな}を{釣|つ}りました。
examples.english: I caught fish in this river.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{水|みず}がきれいです。
{隅田川|すみだがわ}は{東京|とうきょう}にあります。
examples.english: The Sumida River is in Tokyo.
examples.notes: 川 becomes がわ in compound names

notes: In compound words and river names, the reading often changes to がわ: {隅田川|すみだがわ}, {多摩川|たまがわ}. Related: {川岸|かわぎし} (riverbank), {小川|おがわ} (stream, brook).
